en.title: Slovenia snow today: fresh snow on Kanin, Krvavec and Pokljuka, 19 November 2026
en.description: Snow is falling on Slovenia's ski mountains today: about 37 cm on Kanin and 21 cm on Krvavec. Where the snow lies, how it compares with past winters, and the next snowy day.
en.lede: Thursday 19 November is the snowiest day in Slovenia's mountains since last weekend. The upper slopes of Kanin, on the border with Italy, pick up about 37 cm today, Krvavec 21 cm, Pokljuka 18 cm and Vogel 12 cm. It lands on what was left of the snow of 13 November, so 14 of Slovenia's 19 higher ski areas are white today, and six of them have 10 cm or more on the ground.

sections.h: Where the snow is deepest today
p: Kanin leads by a wide margin, with 28 cm on its upper slopes below the top lift at 2,137 m. Kranjska Gora has 20 cm on its higher runs, 9 cm of it fresh today. Vogel, above Lake Bohinj with lifts to 1,731 m, has 16 cm. On Pohorje, Kope still holds 14 cm, mostly from last weekend. Pokljuka has 13 cm and Krvavec, the big ski area above Ljubljana airport, 10 cm at the top, nearly all of it new.
Further east the cover is thin: Velika planina and Rogla have 5 cm each, Mariborsko Pohorje 3 cm. The lower ski hills that were white last weekend, Gače, Sviščaki and Trije Kralji, are bare again.

A week ago, on 12 November, Slovenia's ski mountains were close to bare: Vogel had 1 cm on its upper slopes, Krvavec and Kranjska Gora none. Then the snowfall of Friday 13 November reached almost every range. By Saturday 14 November Vogel had 30 cm, Rogla and Velika planina 19 cm, Golte 18 cm and Soriška planina 17 cm. Even Gače, whose lifts only climb to 964 m, had 38 cm. Kope peaked on Sunday 15 November with 29 cm and Mariborsko Pohorje with 13 cm. That Sunday, 16 of the 19 ski areas were white.
Milder days followed. By Wednesday 18 November Vogel was down to 19 cm, Rogla and Velika planina to 6 cm, and Gače and Sviščaki were bare. Today's snow puts the high Julian Alps back in front.

The weather station at Kredarica, at 2,515 m below the summit of Triglav, measured 30 cm of snow every morning from 14 to 19 November: up there, winter has settled in. Lower down the story changes. The station at Vojsko, at 1,067 m above Idrija, had 10 cm on 14 November and 8 cm on 15 November, then bare ground from 16 November. Rateče, at 864 m near Kranjska Gora, and Ljubljana stayed snow-free all week.
So the snow you see on the slopes is mountain snow. Villages and valleys are still green, which matters if you are driving up or hoping to cross-country ski at low height.

At Kanin's middle height, around 1,622 m, there are 19 cm today. In past winters the typical depth there on 19 November was only 2 cm, and only one winter in four had more than 10 cm. Pokljuka at 1,413 m has 5 cm, against a typical 2 cm; Vogel at 1,152 m has 3 cm, against 1 cm; Krvavec at 1,718 m has 2 cm, where bare ground is typical for the date.

Kranjska Gora is the exception: its middle height, at 1,188 m, is bare today, while a typical year has about 2 cm there. In short, the high Julian Alps are ahead of the usual calendar, the middle of the mountains is about normal, and the lower slopes are where they usually are in mid-November.

Friday 20 and Saturday 21 November are dry in all forecasts, which gives the new snow time to settle. The next snowy day is Sunday 22 November, mainly in the west: Kranjska Gora 7 to 13 cm on its upper slopes, with 10 cm in the middle forecast; Vogel 4 to 15 cm, middle 6 cm; Pokljuka 1 to 12 cm, middle 5 cm; Krvavec 0 to 5 cm, middle 4 cm.

The east waits until Thursday 26 November, when Mariborsko Pohorje could get 0 to 7 cm (middle 4 cm) and Rogla about 3 cm. Over the whole week from 20 to 26 November the middle forecast gives about 12 cm for Kranjska Gora (8 to 15 cm), 7 cm for Vogel (5 to 17 cm) and Mariborsko Pohorje (0 to 10 cm), 6 cm for Pokljuka, 5 cm for Rogla and 4 cm for Krvavec.

Fresh snow on the upper slopes does not mean the lifts are turning. Slovenian ski areas open when they have a solid base, often with their own snow on the main runs, so check each resort's own channels before you go. For natural snow, Kanin and Vogel are the best bets right now, with Kranjska Gora and Pokljuka next.

Ski touring is tempting after a day like today, but the new snow lies on a thin, uneven old cover and on grass: stay on gentle terrain. To the south, Croatia's mountains are bare again after last weekend, and Bosnia and Herzegovina is waiting for snow later next week.

advice: Today's snow is mountain snow: Kanin, Kranjska Gora, Vogel, Pokljuka and Krvavec are white, valleys are green.
Next snowy day: Sunday 22 November, mostly the Julian Alps.
Check each ski area's own channels for opening news.

sl.title: Sneg v Sloveniji danes: nov sneg na Kaninu, Krvavcu in Pokljuki, 19. november 2026
sl.description: Danes sneži v slovenskih smučarskih gorah: okoli 37 cm na Kaninu in 21 cm na Krvavcu. Kje leži sneg, kako se primerja s preteklimi zimami in kdaj bo spet snežilo.
sl.lede: Četrtek, 19. november, je najbolj snežen dan v slovenskih gorah po minulem koncu tedna. Na zgornjih progah Kanina ob meji z Italijo danes zapade okoli 37 cm snega, na Krvavcu 21 cm, na Pokljuki 18 cm in na Voglu 12 cm. Sneg pada na ostanke snega s 13. novembra, zato je danes belih 14 od 19 višjih slovenskih smučišč, šest jih ima 10 cm ali več.

p: Kanin je močno v vodstvu z 28 cm na zgornjih progah pod zgornjo postajo na 2137 m. Kranjska Gora ima na višjih progah 20 cm, od tega 9 cm današnjega. Vogel nad Bohinjskim jezerom, z žičnicami do 1731 m, ima 16 cm. Na Pohorju Kope še držijo 14 cm, večinoma od minulega konca tedna. Pokljuka ima 13 cm, Krvavec nad letališčem 10 cm na vrhu, skoraj vse novo.
Bolj proti vzhodu je snega malo: Velika planina in Rogla imata po 5 cm, Mariborsko Pohorje 3 cm. Nižja smučišča, ki so bila bela minuli konec tedna, Gače, Sviščaki in Trije Kralji, so spet kopna.

Pred tednom dni, 12. novembra, so bile slovenske smučarske gore skoraj kopne: Vogel je imel na zgornjih progah 1 cm, Krvavec in Kranjska Gora nič. Potem je sneženje v petek, 13. novembra, zajelo skoraj vsa pogorja. Do sobote, 14. novembra, je imel Vogel 30 cm, Rogla in Velika planina 19 cm, Golte 18 cm in Soriška planina 17 cm. Celo Gače, kjer žičnice segajo le do 964 m, so imele 38 cm. Kope so dosegle vrh v nedeljo, 15. novembra, z 29 cm, Mariborsko Pohorje s 13 cm. Tisto nedeljo je bilo belih 16 od 19 smučišč.

Sledili so milejši dnevi. Do srede, 18. novembra, je Vogel padel na 19 cm, Rogla in Velika planina na 6 cm, Gače in Sviščaki so bili kopni. Današnji sneg spet postavlja visoke Julijske Alpe v ospredje.

Postaja Kredarica na 2515 m pod vrhom Triglava je od 14. do 19. novembra vsako jutro izmerila 30 cm snega: tam zgoraj se je zima že ustalila. Niže je slika drugačna. Postaja Vojsko na 1067 m nad Idrijo je imela 10 cm 14. novembra in 8 cm 15. novembra, od 16. novembra pa kopno. Rateče na 864 m pri Kranjski Gori in Ljubljana so bile ves teden brez snega.
Sneg, ki ga vidite na progah, je torej gorski sneg. Vasi in doline so še zelene, kar je pomembno za vožnjo v hribe in za tek na smučeh na nizki nadmorski višini.

Na sredini Kanina, okoli 1622 m, je danes 19 cm. V preteklih zimah je bila tam 19. novembra običajna višina le 2 cm in le vsaka četrta zima je imela več kot 10 cm. Pokljuka na 1413 m ima 5 cm proti običajnim 2 cm, Vogel na 1152 m 3 cm proti 1 cm, Krvavec na 1718 m 2 cm, kjer je za ta datum običajno kopno.

Izjema je Kranjska Gora: njena sredina na 1188 m je danes kopna, običajno leto pa ima tam okoli 2 cm. Na kratko: visoke Julijske Alpe so pred običajnim koledarjem, srednji pas gora je približno normalen, nižje proge pa so tam, kjer so sredi novembra običajno.

Petek, 20., in sobota, 21. novembra, sta po vseh napovedih suha, kar novemu snegu da čas, da se sesede. Naslednji snežni dan je nedelja, 22. novembra, predvsem na zahodu: Kranjska Gora 7 do 13 cm na zgornjih progah, srednja napoved 10 cm; Vogel 4 do 15 cm, srednje 6 cm; Pokljuka 1 do 12 cm, srednje 5 cm; Krvavec 0 do 5 cm, srednje 4 cm.

Vzhod čaka do četrtka, 26. novembra, ko bi Mariborsko Pohorje lahko dobilo 0 do 7 cm (srednje 4 cm), Rogla pa okoli 3 cm. Za ves teden od 20. do 26. novembra srednja napoved da okoli 12 cm za Kranjsko Goro (8 do 15 cm), 7 cm za Vogel (5 do 17 cm) in Mariborsko Pohorje (0 do 10 cm), 6 cm za Pokljuko, 5 cm za Roglo in 4 cm za Krvavec.

Nov sneg na zgornjih progah še ne pomeni, da žičnice obratujejo. Slovenska smučišča odprejo, ko imajo trdno podlago, pogosto z lastnim snegom na glavnih progah, zato pred odhodom preverite uradne kanale smučišča. Za naravni sneg sta trenutno najboljša Kanin in Vogel, sledita Kranjska Gora in Pokljuka.

Turno smučanje je po takem dnevu mamljivo, a nov sneg leži na tanki, neenakomerni stari podlagi in na travi: ostanite na položnem terenu. Na jugu so hrvaške gore po minulem koncu tedna spet kopne, Bosna in Hercegovina pa sneg čaka konec prihodnjega tedna.

advice: Današnji sneg je gorski sneg: Kanin, Kranjska Gora, Vogel, Pokljuka in Krvavec so beli, doline zelene.
Naslednji snežni dan: nedelja, 22. november, predvsem v Julijskih Alpah.
Za novice o odprtju preverite uradne kanale smučišč.
